To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
unsupervised methods are capable of acquiring large corpora of paraphrase data from news articles, and that these corpora are more useful than previously believed.

(1) unsupervised techniques can be used to extract large corpora of monolingual sentence paraphrases, (2) these techniques are effective at producing sentence pairs that are similar enough for alignment, (3) these techniques are not effective at producing sentence paraphrases, and (4) paraphrase data is useful for a variety of NLP tasks.
